Include failure/timed_out jobs; include cancelled jobs only for a completed cancelled parent and mark non-product diagnosis. Preserve explicit CANCELLED_NO_FAILED_JOB and STARTUP_FAILURE_NO_JOB_LOG metadata when no eligible job exists. Reject all other unsupported or empty states. Preserve the original run_conclusion for downstream supersession.
